title: A Multi-Agent Framework for Mitigating Dialect Biases in Privacy Policy Question-Answering Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing question-answering performance (accuracy and F1 scores) disparities between Standard American English (SAE) and 50 non-standard English dialects (synthetically generated using the Multi-VALUE rule-based translation framework) on privacy policy datasets (PrivacyQA and PolicyQA).
